title: GSC engine-emitted event catalogue
description: One game's events the engine notifies (the names scripts `waittill`): every call site of the VM's notify found in the executable, its event, receiver and pushed arguments. Validates events/<engine-id>.toml after TOML parsing. Facts only: names, hashes, counts, types and how each was measured; no game code, no script text.

extractor.description: The gruff script that produced the file.

dump.description: Executable file name and its sha256, never a path.

hash_family.description: gsc_hash family id of the `hash` fields (t7.canon ...), for hashed engines.

engine_sites.description: Call sites of the notifiers found in the executable.

named.description: Events of this file that carry a name.

corpus_waittill_events.description: Distinct literal events of waittill/waittillmatch in the game's script corpus.

explained_by_engine.description: Waited events no script notifies that this catalogue holds.

explained_by_scripts.description: Waited events some script notifies with a literal.

unexplained.description: Waited events neither: listed in the extractor's report.

complete.description: True only when every engine notify site was resolved and named: then an event neither here nor in any script is notified by nothing (rule T001).

name_source.description: Where the name comes from: string literal, scr_const, image string, corpus.

args.description: The values the engine pushes, in waittill order.

vm_type.description: The VM's own type name when `type` does not say it (hash, weapon, pointer ...).

args_variable.description: The call sites disagree on the count; `args` is then the largest.
